about: Every page a scan of /docs/ on this site should visit, and the 9 hard cases from the crawl-coverage ticket. Served by audit.crawl_coverage_eval, which fills in {{ORIGIN}} in .txt and .xml files, answers redirects below with 301, and matches paths without regard to letter case (as many servers do).

hard_cases.label: A page only in the sitemap
hard_cases.note: archive.html is in the sitemap robots.txt names (through a sitemap index); annual-report.html is in /sitemap.xml. No link leads to either.

hard_cases.label: A page 11 clicks deep
hard_cases.note: Visited when the depth limit allows 11 steps; with the default limit of 10 it is counted as not visited because of the depth limit.

hard_cases.label: A page reached only by a button
hard_cases.note: calculator.html is behind an onclick button; results.html behind a form that is only a button. The search form and the POST form must not be followed.

hard_cases.label: URL variants (slash, letter case, extra query text)
hard_cases.note: /docs/About.html, /docs/about.html?utm_source=newsletter and /docs/guides (no slash) must not become extra pages.

hard_cases.label: A redirect
hard_cases.note: /docs/old-news.html answers 301 to /docs/news.html, which about.html also links to.
